note: Each item is a falsifiable acceptance oracle. 'measured_not_adopted' is a passing outcome where marked.

items.assert: A 50ms injected local delay moves local_overhead_seconds by ~50ms and leaves ttft_seconds statistically unchanged.
Provider IQR is reported at N>=30 so any later delta can be compared against noise.
ai-gateway-agent-runtime image is <=150MB and passes its healthcheck and the live suite.
No image tag literal exists outside lock.json; editing a capability-worker file leaves the agent-runtime tag unchanged.
An injected control-plane import inside a data-plane turn path makes make plane-boundary-gate fail.
Under an N-worker admission fuzz the capacity budget is never oversold, and each rate-limit dimension is counted exactly once.
SSE fixture replay is byte-identical between Python and Rust model planes, including error and cancellation frames.
Rust RSS at 50 concurrent streams is >=60% below Python, OR the phase closes as measured_not_adopted with the numbers recorded.
A heavy eval batch moves neither streaming p99 nor local_overhead_seconds.
A 200-page PDF ingest raises interactive retrieval p99 by <=10% while N>1 workers run without double-claiming.
Native chunk kernels reproduce Python chunk boundaries byte-for-byte over the corpus, OR the kernel work is cancelled and recorded.
Legacy sessions render identical history through the public API after the store is unified, and session delete still tombstones without violating the runtime FK.
At least one configuration reaches TTFT p50 <=3.41s at N>=30 without losing the eight-scenario cohort, OR the ceiling is declared unreachable with an evidenced replacement.
current-to-frozen-to-current rollback preserves session and execution-ledger fingerprints exactly, and the recorded evidence names the shipped images.
Every phase ends with the live suite at >=141 passed / 0 failed and the Python suite at 0 failed.
